title: Corrugated (Ag) Panels
description: Choose our Corrugated (Ag) Panels for long-lasting, weather-resistant agricultural roofing. Perfect for barns, sheds, and farm buildings.

sections.text: The AG Panel also known as the Rib Panel is a lightweight, exposed fastener roofing system that is most popular for agricultural buildings, storage facilities, and canopies. With ease of installation in mind, the AG Panel system is a straightforward installation with clean look and simplicity in mind.
